findings.desc: doc-code-drift: lifecycle-artifact-scope.md §Contract point 2 and execution-plan §Implementation Status both state that `lattice agent_prompt` serves content from `promptRegistryManifest()`, but the actual implementation calls `readPromptTemplate(entry)` (reads raw file bytes from templates/agents/*.md). `promptRegistryManifest()` returns only manifest metadata (schemaVersion/source/agentCount/materialHash), not template content. The behavioral outcome (same-source read) is correct, but the API reference is wrong and could mislead a developer to call the wrong function.
findings.resolvedReason: 修正 lifecycle-artifact-scope.md 契约点2 + runtime-owned plan Implementation Status + CLAUDE.md:agent_prompt 实为 readPromptTemplate 读 templates/agents/<role>.md 原文,promptRegistryManifest() 仅是该模板集的指纹清单(元数据非正文);内容单一源仍是 templates/agents,与 Codex 同源。commit 8e... docs fix

findings.desc: concept-cleanup: agent-symlink deletion incomplete: packages/main/src/cli-init.ts line 3 still imports symlinkSync and readlinkSync from fs but both symbols became unused when the [5/6] symlink-based agent sync code was replaced by the thin-shim syncGlobalAgents() approach. The import suggests symlinks are still used for agent files, misleading future readers and creating dead code.
findings.resolvedReason: Removed unused symlinkSync and readlinkSync from the node:fs import in packages/main/src/cli-init.ts (both appeared only on the import line, orphaned by the symlink->thin-shim migration). Verified each remaining symbol (lstatSync at line 960 etc.) is still used so kept those. npm --prefix packages/main run build green (tsc clean); lattice validate all green (PASS).
